title: EVIDENCE FOR A SINGLE ELECTRON TRANSFER ACTIVATION IN THE HYDRIDE TRANSFER FROM AN NADH MODEL COMPOUND TO TETRACYANOETHYLENE
abstract: Abstract                New evidence for a stepwise mechanism which requires a single electron transfer activation in the hydride transfer from an NADH model compound, 1-benzyl-1,4-dihydronicotinamide (BNAH), to tetracyanoethylene (TCNE) has been presented based on the effects of pyridine on the stoichiometry of the overall reaction, the rate constant, and the kinetic isotope effect.
